as_stored.implied_outcome: Using Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.61 billion and Q2 guidance of $91 billion, the implied sequential growth rate is about 11.5%. Carrying that rate through Q3 and Q4 gives approximately $387.2 billion for FY2027 ($81.61B + $91B + $101.5B + $113.1B).

FY2026 revenue above $215.9 billion carried forward at the cited 82% FY2027 growth estimate implies about $393 billion ($215.9 billion × 1.82); NVIDIA’s $91 billion Q2 guidance supports the near-term growth trajectory but does not itself quantify a full-year revision.

Carrying FY2026 revenue of more than $215.9 billion forward at Q1 FY2027's 85.2% year-over-year growth implies roughly $399.8 billion using the cited revenue floor. Q2 guidance of $91 billion supports the strong near-term trajectory but, without a prior-year Q2 comparison, does not yield a more precise annual figure.
